q1.answer_given: The case (custom hard plastic or other material, protecting the remote and locator) and the circuit board (custom each time to route button input to output) need custom design. Standard parts are the buttons/iPod-style wheel, infrared LED (bundled with the circuit board), radio sender/receiver, and a beeper/buzzer for locating the remote. Material options are rubber (needs rubber buttons, incompatible with plastic buttons), plastic, wood (viable but no strong reason to choose it), and titanium (discouraged - heavy, only usable in flat cases). Choosing the iPod-style wheel requires the pricier 'regular' chip instead of the minimal chip.
